firstPlayerRule: After players look at their secret roles, randomly select the first Presidential Candidate and give that player both the President and Chancellor placards.
clarifications: At the start of each new round, the President placard moves clockwise to the next player, who becomes the new Presidential Candidate.
The Presidential Candidate then nominates a Chancellor, and everyone votes on the government.
